title: 第516章 小龙女
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下一秒，云峰则瞬移到了三眼真君的面前，用手掐住了他的脖子，将他举了起来。

“你还有什么遗言说吧，快点说，不然没机会了。”

云峰看着三眼真君的眼睛冷冷地道，真君是他的敌人，自然是要杀的。

不过云峰要给他留下遗言的机会。

“我没什么遗言，要杀就杀，何必多言？”

三眼真君叹了口气，事已至此，成王败寇，他没什么好说的了。

“那好，你安息吧。”

云峰点了点头，打算使用吸精大法吸死三眼真君，哪知道就在此刻他忽然听到了背后传来了二师姐的声音。

“你是谁？救命啊……”

云峰猛地回过了头，却发现二师姐马蓉竟被束缚住了，一个金发披肩，容貌俏丽，额头上有两只角的少女正掐住了二师姐的脖子。

“放开三眼郎，不然我掐死你的女人！你不想你的女人死吧？”

这个额头上两只角的少女则冷冷地道。

她不是别人，赫然是西海三公主，三眼真君的前女友，小龙女。

原来三眼真君在很久之前是谈过一个女朋友的，就是小龙女，不过后来三眼真君因为师妹茉莉和重重原因不喜欢小龙女了，就和龙女分了手。

但是小龙女却一直爱着三眼真君，毕竟她的第一次都给了三眼郎。

这段时间她一直都是潜伏在这岛屿附近，刚才的大战她也都看在了眼里，如今看到三眼真君遇到了危险，她自然前来解救。

“龙儿，是你？你怎么……在这里？”

此刻，三眼真君也睁大了眼睛，没想到前女友小龙女出现了，他心里有点意外，毕竟他都和小龙女分手了好多年了。

“放开我二师姐！”

再看云峰这里，看到马蓉都被掐得翻白眼了，云峰大怒，让龙女放人。

“你先放了三眼郎，我就放你的女人。”

小龙女不依不饶，要云峰放人。

“你先放。”

“你先放！”

云峰和小龙女不依不饶，都要对方先放人。

“这样吧，我喊一二三，我们一起放人。”

云峰想了想则笑了起来。

“好吧，就这样。”

小龙女想了想则说道。

“三！”

云峰喊道。

“二！”

云峰继续，嘴角浮现了一丝笑容。

“一！”

“放人！”

云峰和小龙女不约而同地将手里的人朝着对方丢了过去，哪知道就在三眼真君即将落到小龙女面前的时候，云峰忽然隔空一巴掌拍出，打在了三眼真君的背上。

三眼真君再次被轰得飞了出去，重重地砸在了地面泥土里，狼狈不堪。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The next second, Yunfeng teleported in front of the Three-Eyed True Monarch, grabbed his neck with his hands, and lifted him up.

"If you have any last words, please say them quickly, otherwise you won't have a chance."

Yunfeng looked into the eyes of True Lord Three Eyes and said coldly, True Lord was his enemy and he would naturally kill him.

But Yunfeng wanted to give him a chance to leave his last words.

"I don't have any last words. If you want to kill, just kill. Why bother to say more?"

The Three-Eyed Lord sighed, the matter was over, the winner was the king and the loser was the bandit, he had nothing more to say.

"Well, rest in peace."

Yunfeng nodded and planned to use the semen-absorbing technique to suck the Three-Eyed Lord to death. Unexpectedly, at this moment, he suddenly heard the voice of the Second Senior Sister from behind.

"Who are you? Help..."

Yunfeng turned his head suddenly, only to find that the second senior sister Ma Rong was actually restrained. A pretty girl with blond hair and a shawl and two horns on her forehead was strangling the second senior sister's neck.

"Let go of the three-eyed man, or I will strangle your woman to death! You don't want your woman to die, do you?"

The girl with two horns on her forehead said coldly.

She is none other than the Third Princess of the West Sea, the ex-girlfriend of the Three-Eyed True Monarch, Xiao Longnu.

It turns out that the Three-Eyed Lord had a girlfriend a long time ago, Xiao Longnu. However, later the Three-Eyed Lord didn't like the Little Dragon Girl because of his junior sister Jasmine and various reasons, so he broke up with her.

But Xiao Longnu has always loved the Three-Eyed Lord. After all, her first time was given to the Three-Eyed Lord.

During this period of time, she had been lurking near the island, and she had witnessed the battle just now. Now that she saw the Three-Eyed Lord in danger, she naturally came to rescue him.

"Long'er, is it you? Why are you...here?"

At this moment, the Three-Eyed Lord also opened his eyes wide. He did not expect his ex-girlfriend Xiao Longnv to appear. He was a little surprised. After all, he and Xiao Longnv had broken up for many years.

"Let go of my second senior sister!"

Looking at Yunfeng again, he saw that Ma Rong was so pinched that she rolled her eyes. Yunfeng was furious and asked Long Nu to let her go.

"You let the three-eyed man go first, and then I'll let your woman go."

Xiao Longnu refused to give up and asked Yunfeng to let him go.

"You let go first."

"You let go first!"

Yunfeng and Xiao Longnu refused to let go, demanding that the other party let him go first.

"Let's do this. I'll shout one, two, three, and we'll let him go together."

Yunfeng thought about it and laughed.

"Okay, that's it."

Xiao Longnu thought for a while and then said.

"Three!"

Yunfeng shouted.

"Two!"

Yunfeng continued, a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.

"One!"

"Let them go!"

Yunfeng and Xiao Longnu coincidentally threw the people in their hands toward each other. Unexpectedly, just when the Three-Eyed Lord was about to fall in front of Xiao Longnu, Yunfeng suddenly slapped the Three-Eyed Lord on the back.

The Three-Eyed True Monarch was blasted away again and hit the ground heavily in the dirt, in a miserable state.
